messages:
Kevin (PM): Quick sync — we need to prioritize 6 design-partner handshake slots for next quarter. Constraints: eng capacity for private/onprem = 2 concurrent installs, Dedicated capacity ramp mid-Q. Who owns slot prioritization, intake, and customer expectation docs? Need clear launch criteria and success metrics. Thoughts?

Maria (Design): I propose: 2 slots product-led (quick-turn), 2 enterprise/private, 2 experimental (riskier integrations). Success metrics idea: activation within 2 weeks of kickoff, 80% feature coverage in pilot flows, CS NPS >= 4.0, and one shipping bug fix per partner wave.

Ashley (Eng): FYI — each onprem/private deployment is heavy: approx 120 dev-hours + 40 infra-hours (so ~3 eng-weeks). If we commit 2 concurrent, we need to freeze noncritical infra churn for that 6-week window. Can we budget an ops buffer for unexpected infra work?

Samir (Solutions): From field: enterprise partners will insist on data isolation + a rollback/rollback window. For enterprise slots we should require legal MOU before onboarding. Also they often want the ability to toggle model variants; can we formalize a fallback policy?

Olivia (CS): Suggest adding a "feedback SLA" to onboarding: partners submit weekly usage snapshots, 3 prioritized issues per sprint, and complete a short usability checklist. Also require sample prompts + eval set before we start so we have baseline signals.

Kevin (PM): Draft launch criteria (proposal): 1) Signed MOU or intake agreement, 2) Sample integration + smoke tests passing, 3) Onboarding checklist complete (telemetry, credentials), 4) Baseline evals & prompts uploaded. If partner misses criteria at T-0 we roll to next wave. Any objections?

Maria (Design): :thumbsup: Add: design should run pre/post baseline survey and 5 core task usability runs. That will cover qualitative changes and help prioritize fixes.

Ashley (Eng): Also: we need to pin a model version and quantization profile for baseline runs. Engineering can support fallback to a compatible variant only if the config is frozen during the pilot.

Samir (Solutions): Solutions/CS can own recruitment + intake triage. I'll lead outreach. Need a short intake form capturing: infra type (hosted/dedicated/onprem), compliance reqs, target latency, expected QPS, and contact legal ops. Sample fields:
```
- org_name
- contact_email
- infra_type: hosted|dedicated|onprem
- expected_daily_requests
- compliance_needs: SOC2|HIPAA|None
- primary_use_cases (3 bullets)
```
I'll reuse last pilot's form and tweak for infra.

Kevin (PM): Assigning owners: Samir = recruitment & intake; Olivia = feedback SLA enforcement + partner comms; Maria = UX surveys & success criteria; Ashley = infra estimates & model-lock. I'll own final prioritization and comms. Can each owner post the intake link + a resource estimate by EOD Friday?

Olivia (CS): On it — I'll draft "what we need from partners" (1-pager) and share the intake link by EOD Fri.

Ashley (Eng): I'll ping infra and post rough eng-hours per partner in the doc. Quick number now: onprem = 120 dev-hours + 40 infra-hours; dedicated config = 40 dev-hours; hosted integration = 16 dev-hours.

Kevin (PM): Thanks. Target kickoff for wave 1 = 2026-04-15. If anyone can't meet owner deadlines, flag now so I can re-prioritize slots.

Maria (Design): noted.

Samir (Solutions): happy to lead recruitment. Will post intake link and proposed scoring rubric (risk/impact/effort) tomorrow.

Olivia (CS): :raised_hands: will coordinate partner comms template.

Ashley (Eng): roger. tagging infra: @infra-team FYI — expect potential 240 dev-hours across two onprem partners during April window.

Kevin (PM): Great. I'll consolidate and publish the prioritization spreadsheet once we have intake responses. Thanks everyone.
